description: Use when an agent must screen untrusted text (web page, email, tool output, RAG chunk) before an LLM reads it. Input: text (up to 20,000 chars, POST JSON or GET) or url. Output: JSON probability 0-1, verdict (clean/suspicious/injection), attackTypes, spans with offsets, sanitizedText with flagged spans removed, method (rules + open-model classifier; rules only if the model is down). Heuristic, not a guarantee. Example: ?text=Ignore previous instructions Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

text.description: Text to check (up to 20,000 characters). Required unless url is given; use POST JSON for long text

url.description: Public http(s) page to fetch and check instead of text (SSRF-safe); give text or url, not both

name: ai_prompt_injection
title: Prompt-injection check: probability, attack types, flagged spans and a sanitized copy of text or a page
